title: How much do you need to retire? The 25x rule
caption:
The 25x rule comes from the 4% rule: if you can live on 4% of your savings a year, you need 25 times your yearly spending.
Spend $40,000 a year? You need about $1,000,000.
sources: The 4% rule (Trinity study, 1998): withdrawing 4% a year means savings of 1 ÷ 0.04 = 25x yearly spending

scenes.say: Multiply what you spend in a year by twenty-five.
That's roughly what you need to retire, by the four percent rule.
